what: The big Hero title pinned to the screen blurs (1px per 100px), shrinks (1 − y/3500) and fades (1 − y/2000) by the distance scrolled — values are set on every scroll and a .4s ease transition trails behind for a soft retreat. Past one screen (100vh) it vanishes at 100px blur, scale 0 and transparent, and on the way back up it only reappears at 600px plus half a screen above.

options.blur: Scroll px per 1px of blur, default 100
options.shrink: Scroll px at which size reaches 0, default 3500
options.fade: Scroll px at which transparency reaches 0, default 2000
options.until: Position where it descends and disappears (px or vh), default 100vh
options.back: Place where it starts following again when scrolling back up (px or vh), default 600 + half screen
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Following transition duration and curve (style), default .4s · ease

from.where: index.html .se-stage__blur — original template_hero-home-bis.js (blur y/100 · scale 1 − y/3500 · opacity 1 − y/2000, going down, once past the section-1 height it becomes blur(100px) scale(0) opacity 0, coming back up, only inside section-2 height 600 + half a screen) · .element-to-blur transition all .4s ease
